title: RAVA Digital Atelier — Product-pure release stage
prompt: A product-pure Persian RTL RAVA TEAM homepage with a large finished service website peeling into semantic wireframe, responsive mobile previews and a Draft-to-Preview-to-Published rail. Use a precise optical-dock 3D glass Navbar, a layered task-oriented Platform mega menu, compact sculpted controls, luminous pearl surfaces and navy/cobalt type. The product artifact outweighs marketing copy; no physical architecture, abstract objects, fake proof or generic card grids.
